hypothesis: At least 480 of the exact 512 disjoint FiveK pairs can be normalized deterministically with content alignment, zero prior-pool leakage, broad camera support and a target-blind whole-camera development/confirmation split, while preserving both aligned Expert C and the safe filtered control.

normalization.source_decode: project WorkingImage generic RAW decode then exact sRGB encoding
normalization.target_decode: Expert-C ProPhoto RGB16 TIFF through pinned ProPhoto-to-D50-to-D65-to-sRGB conversion
normalization.crop_policy: geometry-only centered source crop to target aspect ratio
normalization.resize_policy: Lanczos4, preserve source crop aspect, maximum side 256, then target to exact source shape

split.method: target-blind whole-camera subset-sum nearest fixed target

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: freeze this exact population and open only the preregistered off-diagonal explicit-operator Oracle
branch_rules.alignment_fails: close failed rows without manual crop, per-image registration or row substitution
branch_rules.support_or_leakage_fails: close BQ1 and retain the data only as an internal digital-retouch diagnostic
branch_rules.split_fails: close this selection without target-aware reassignment or weakening camera-group isolation

claim_ceiling: data-only deterministic FiveK digital-retouch normalization, alignment, leakage, camera support and target-blind split evidence; no operator, router, film, stock, calibration, preference or product claim
